name: traversy-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods from Brad Traversy

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: Shows the current Git branch, context, and account usage above the prompt with detailed session information

plugins.name: impact-map
plugins.description: Groups session file activity by folder with change totals and current Git diffs

plugins.name: tool-cards
plugins.description: Replaces tool-use rows with diagnostic cards that show status, timing, results, and details

plugins.name: verification-ledger
plugins.description: Shows release readiness across local checks, Git state, and GitHub Actions

plugins.name: agent-pulse
plugins.description: Shows a live subagent roster with current activity and recent transcripts

plugins.name: work-queue
plugins.description: Shows Claude's live progress, focused work, named blockers, ready tasks, and completed work
